_about: Runa's notebook for THIS company: who people are, nicknames for places and suppliers, which trucks belong to whom. Every company gets its own copy of this file. These are the starting notes; Runa proposes new ones from the chat and a supervisor approves them with /setuju. Notes only help Runa tell WHICH delivery a message is about. They never change the rules in the code.
notes: Budi: Carrier driver for PT Sinar Baja Logistik. Usually runs the Cikampek route. Currently assigned to delivery 0080004521.
